matrix.baselines_evaluated: 9 uninterrupted (relu/topk/jumprelu x 3 seeds) + P1 JumpReLU seed 42
matrix.method_a: relu x3, jumprelu x3 (new), topk x3 (existing pilot checkpoints, reused), P1-JumpReLU base x1 (new, descriptive)
matrix.repro_check: topk seed 42 retrained with this script; must equal the pilot checkpoint; excluded from results

sparsity_control: ReLU/JumpReLU: training penalty kept, controller continued from the base coefficient (target 128, every 25 steps, rate 0.5, EMA L0 on OWT rows); TopK: none
evaluation: validation only; independent probes fitted on ORIGINAL activations of train groups B (logistic with C chosen on original validation, MLP x5 seeds, mass-mean); decodability diagnostic; OWT, GoT, RepE reconstruction and L0 reported separately; splicing (OWT CE/KL, GoT statement KL, cities preference, RepE final KL, persona-shift cosine); RepE frozen probes and direction fidelity. No probe, validation or test result is used for training or selection.

success_criteria.primary_per_architecture: GoT geographic B-MLP gap (mean of 5 probe seeds): method_a < paired base AND < paired owt_only on all 3 seeds, mean paired difference > 2 x its sd
success_criteria.secondary: same test for the B-logistic gap and for the numerical domain (reported, not required)
guards_per_architecture: L0 matched: OWT-validation L0 of every method_a seed within +-5 % of its base
OWT splice delta CE <= 1.10 x base on every seed
OWT validation EV >= base - 0.005 on every seed
GoT cities truth-preference change >= base - 0.018 (mean over seeds)
RepE validation mass-mean gap <= base + 0.02 (mean over seeds)
success_criteria.success: primary AND all guards (per architecture); P1 JumpReLU base is descriptive only
